author: reek
body: A sector read whose destination is a page the guest has never touched. This program killed the emulator outright before codex-vm learned to commit the destination of a host-performed store, and it is here so that it cannot happen again quietly.

author: reek
body: The disk sidecar is 64 KB, far smaller than the 1.5 MB read below, so most of these reads are refused by the controller for being out of range. It failed anyway when it failed: the defect was in where the answer was written, never in whether there was an answer to write.
